## Connect in three steps

AI agents can discover and use the service through standard protocols.

- Obtain a token through the x402 payment flow or direct crypto payment

- Configure SOCKS5 with your chosen exit point

- Pass your token as the SOCKS5 username and password (RFC 1929)

# connect through the US East exit curl --socks5-hostname "YOUR_TOKEN: [email protected] :1080" \ https://api.example.com
